Info

Dedicated controller adapter for manual robot axis jogging and feedrate override.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.communication.controller.jog_controller.JogController(raw_channel: IRawChannel, frame_builder: IBinaryFrameBuilder, protocol_mode: ProtocolMode)[source]¶

Bases: BaseSubController

Dedicated controller adapter for manual axis jogging and feedrate override.

It defines:

methods:
jog - Jogs specific robot axis by relative displacement.
set_feedrate_override - Sets execution speed override percentage.
jog(axis: str, step: float) → bool[source]¶

Jogs specific robot axis by relative displacement.

Parameters:

  • axis – Axis identifier string (‘X’, ‘Y’, ‘Z’, ‘Phi’, etc.).

  • step – Relative displacement step value.

Returns:

True if command transmitted successfully, False otherwise.

set_feedrate_override(pct: int) → bool[source]¶

Sets execution speed override percentage.

Parameters:

pct – Speed override percentage between 10 and 200.

Returns:

True if command transmitted successfully, False otherwise.
